title: Access to Opportunity
text:
Educational disparity is frequently attributed to differences in individual effort, yet the evidence points to structural causes. Children raised in neighbourhoods with underfunded schools often begin their studies at a disadvantage that no amount of motivation can easily erase. Over time, these early gaps become entrenched, shaping which careers are accessible and which remain out of reach.

Some educators argue that the most effective remedy is to invest heavily in early childhood programmes, which tend to benefit the least advantaged pupils the most. Others maintain that schools alone cannot compensate for conditions at home, and that housing and employment policies must change as well. Few would deny, however, that communities left marginalised by economic change are the ones most affected when such policies are neglected.

questions.text: According to the passage, what often happens to children from neighbourhoods with underfunded schools?
options: They begin their studies at a disadvantage
They receive scholarships to private schools
They move to wealthier areas at an early age
They lose interest in learning by the age of ten

questions.text: What do some educators consider the most effective remedy?
What can be inferred about the passage's view of individual effort?
options: It is not sufficient on its own to overcome structural disadvantage
It is the main reason for educational success
It has no effect on educational outcomes
It matters only for adult learners

questions.text: What does the author imply about policies that are neglected?
options: They are usually too expensive to be worth implementing
They matter only to school administrators
They tend to harm communities that are already marginalised
They have little influence on children's education

firmly established and difficult to change
a way of solving or correcting a problem
pushed to the edge of society and excluded from its main activities

paragraph_translations: Освітня нерівність часто пояснюють відмінностями в індивідуальних зусиллях, проте дані вказують на структурні причини. Діти, які ростуть у районах із недофінансованими школами, часто починають навчання з невигідного становища, яке не можна легко подолати жодною мотивацією. З часом ці ранні розриви закріплюються і визначають, які професії доступні, а які залишаються недосяжними.

Деякі педагоги стверджують, що найефективнішим засобом є значні інвестиції в програми раннього розвитку дітей, які найбільше допомагають найменш забезпеченим учням. Інші вважають, що школи самі по собі не можуть компенсувати умови вдома і що мають змінитися також житлова та трудова політика. Утім, мало хто заперечуватиме, що найбільше страждають громади, маргіналізовані економічними змінами, коли таку політику ігнорують.
